description:
This one is sold but we’re happy to build something similar or total

Most Magnificent gravel bike ever conceived. El Pebblito.

Blank slate, anything you want, what’s your ultimate gravel bike look like? This is ours.

This was built to showcase how a fast and light we could build our new Pebblito Frameset. 2x GRX, ti cranks, ti post, carbon wheels, super supple rubber. It’s a gravel bike that thinks it might be a road bike. It’s really just a damn fine bike.

El Pebblito is our idea of the ultimate in gravel bike. It’s got road geometry to be fast and nimble but with clearance for 29 x 2.1. That’s right, TWENTY NINE x 2.1. None of this 650b corner cutting nonsence…the big rollers with big rubber, and a road cranks. Tour divide anyone?

We went extra fancy on our tubeset for this one. Columbus gave us their “Life” designation, which is about as baller as it gets for fancy Italian tubing…only thing fancier is “Max”….and wouldn’t you know it, that’s what the top and downtube are…beautifully shaped and swedged, super light and strong. Makes a super light platform that’s still up for some bikepacking. Top tube tank mounts, downtube (top/bottom) anything mounts means it’s ready for some cyclo-touring.

Our new yoke makes the tire clearance wizardy possible. We also designed a new tapered headtube with our cnc engraved logo. Yum.

The last addition to the frameset was a sweet carbon fork from Lithic (wolftooth’s carbon arm), the Hiili. Super light, road/gravel fork with clearance for 29x2.1. some say 2.2…it’s true, tell your friends.
